method: Whole-file manual reading of WinDirStat.h and UiApplication.h; pinned bytes verified. No Windows execution.
findings: Application header owns model/main frame via unique_ptr and central icon handler by value; declaration order implies reverse member destruction but custom destructor implementation remains separate review. Worker wait/task APIs are declarations here, not evidence of completion semantics.

Modal dialog scope stacks thread-local pretranslation targets and shares one WH_MSGFILTER hook, removing it when outermost scope exits. Hook creation failure is not surfaced. OwnerEnableScope restores captured enabled state when owner still exists.

FrameworkDialogProc catches initialization exceptions and aborts creation, catches routed message exceptions without reporting, and detaches on WM_NCDESTROY before PostNcDestroy. Exception containment is not proof requested operation completed.

Default CDialog OnOK/OnCancel close with IDOK/IDCANCEL. This connects earlier custom message-box review: inherited cancel routes do not read the optional checkbox in this header; checkbox is sampled only by its explicit button handlers. Actual keyboard/dialog-manager routing remains untested.

Main pump distinguishes GetMessage error from WM_QUIT: on error it synthesizes quit with exit-1, while ordinary quit preserves wParam. Run performs idle UI update then pumps queued messages. No scan-specific completion gate is present here.

Command routing traverses focused child ancestors, frame, document target and application. Frame destruction posts quit only for current main window and clears application pointer on nonclient destruction.

Frame creation uses scope cleanup for menu/accelerator on failure, transfers accelerator/menu after successful window creation. Layout subtracts visible top/bottom bars without explicit nonnegative remaining-height clamp.
limits: No Windows message pump, modal nesting, shutdown, command routing, resource-failure or task-wait runtime tests executed.
No foreign production code adopted; native pHash investigation deferred. Global completed repository count remains147/500.
